subtitle: Let people book you, no sign-up for them
description:
Share one link and let people book time with you. Your page lives at your own address, like /@avery, with your photo, what you do, your website and profiles, and a link for each kind of meeting you offer, each showing the next time that's open. No account for them, no app, no back-and-forth.

Your free time lies on a strip of days, time running left to right like a video editor's timeline. Guests tap a shaded span and the meeting drops in, the length of the event; they drag it along the day and it snaps to the times that are open. If nothing suits them, they paint when they're free instead, even outside your hours, and where it meets your free time it glows. You see their times over your own week, drag the meeting to a time inside them and accept, or say no with a note.

Both of you get an email with Add to Calendar buttons for Google, Apple and Outlook. The guest can move or cancel with the link in their email. Paint your weekly hours on the same kind of strip, trimming and sliding spans like clips, and keep days off. Guests see times in their own zone, with daylight saving handled on both sides.

Insights show page views, visitors, profile clicks, bookings, time on page, where visitors came from, what they used and where they are, without cookies. And you can run all of it from Claude: connect its MCP connector and it can change your profile, hours and event types, list meetings, answer requests and read your insights.
whatsNew: The timeline opens at the soonest open time, even when your hours cross midnight in a guest's time zone. From 0.2.0: guests drop a meeting into your free time on a timeline of days, or paint when suits them and ask; you settle requests by dragging the meeting into their times and paint your own hours the same way. A profile page, cookieless Insights, and tools to run it all from Claude.
